candidate.name: axios
candidate.claim: AxiosError Serialisation: Made AxiosError#cause non-enumerable to prevent circular JSON serialisation failures when errors include nested causes

notes: The release note also says this prevents circular JSON serialisation failures. Measured on Node 24: the logger-style walk from PR #10913 (JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(err)))) still throws on 1.18.1, because err.request is enumerable and circular. The contract asserts what the claim names, the non-enumerable cause; the wider sentence in the note is not achieved.
